headline: Godcrofts and Stonecradle Lead Overnight Strongpoint Exchanges
war_summary: Since the earlier watch, Godcrofts has kept the fastest pace, recording six strategic-base changes in the latest two-hour tally and fifty-six over the past day. Stonecradle stays lively with three changes in the same window; World's End has been the most worked strongpoint there. Stlican Shelf adds two further changes and now shows no neutral strongpoints, with Fort Hoarfrost the busiest position. Weathered Expanse has logged no fresh strategic-base change since midnight, yet its two-hour casualty count remains enormous, and Mooring County likewise shows heavy losses and enlistments, though no fresh strategic-base change has been listed in the latest two-hour window. Fisherman's Row, prominent in the last dispatch, has gone quiet, while Linn Mercy shows renewed movement in the six-hour figures. The war is still undecided, with strongpoints changing hands chiefly in Godcrofts, Stlican, and Stonecradle.
